caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your phone can actually measure your heartbeat without any special smartwatch or gadget!

Here's how this mind-blowing tech works:
🔹 Your phone's camera or screen uses tiny sensors.
🔹 These sensors shine light onto your skin.
🔹 They detect how much light bounces back, which changes with your blood flow.
🔹 Your heart's pulse creates tiny, measurable ripples in the light reflection.

It's like your phone is a secret pulse detective, all thanks to clever light sensing!
